title: Google’s upcoming Pixel phones are for the fans, even if its launch event isn’t
summary: The majority of Google’s Nexus phones included hardware notification LEDs, and Google was one of the last manufacturers to drop the feature, which saw a brief resurgence in 2017’s Pixel 2 before Google binned it off again — we thought for good.
